answer.text: When riding solo (rider only, unladen), set the rear suspension adjuster to the 3rd notch.
The manual also says the adjuster is kept at the first notch, which differs from the 3rd notch for solo riding, so confirm the setting with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.

policy.text: The rear suspension notch depends on loading: the 3rd notch is for unladen, one-up riding with the rider only, and the 6th notch is for laden or two-up riding.
